input.quote: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: Section 9 contains only cause-based termination rights (material breach, insolvency, security/service/legal/IP failures) and no termination for convenience for either party, while Section 8.1 sets a three-year term and Section 2.1 imposes a USD 2,000,000 annual take-or-pay commitment expressly "without reduction or termination rights." Under the playbook, the absence of any Customer convenience right in a term longer than 12 months is a deviation. We added a 9.4 Customer convenience right on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees and confirmed Vendor has no convenience right during a committed term, and conformed Section 2.1 so the take-or-pay language does not negate that right.

proposal.summary: Add Customer termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund; confirm Vendor has no convenience right; conform take-or-pay language
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives only cause-based rights, so we have no exit during the three-year term; we have added a Customer termination-for-convenience right on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, and confirmed Vendor has no convenience right during a committed term. We have also conformed Section 2.1 so the take-or-pay commitment does not override that right; if helpful, we can discuss 60-90 days' notice with an early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees.

ops.text: 9.4 Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Vendor, in which case Vendor shall refund any prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination and Customer's remaining volume or minimum commitments for the terminated Services are reduced accordingly, without early-termination fee or other penalty. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or an Order Form for convenience during a committed term.

ops.oldText: on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: on a take-or-pay basis, subject to Customer's reduction and termination rights under this Agreement, including Section 9.4.
